# Vendored NexAU v0.3.9

This directory is an unmodified copy of [NexAU](https://github.com/nex-agi/NexAU) at tag `v0.3.9`
(commit `35ee1861546db3cb280a6e17e38a74060d7c96c3`), the agent framework that the AHE evolve agent
runs on. It is vendored because the upstream repository is no longer publicly accessible.

Only the files needed to build and install the package are included: `nexau/`, `pyproject.toml`,
`README.md`, and `LICENSE`. NexAU is distributed under the Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`.
